title: Inter-arrival Time Gap
scenario: Find the time gap (in days) between consecutive orders for each customer.
hint: Use LAG() to compare current date to previous date.
correctQuery: SELECT cust_id, order_date, (order_date - LAG(order_date) OVER(PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY order_date)) AS days_since_last FROM orders;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE orders (cust_id INT, order_date DATE);
